# WAKA 8

> > WAKA 8 is a local news station covering Alabama communities with reporting on government, community events, and human interest stories.

WAKA 8 delivers news coverage across central and south Alabama, featuring reporting from the West Alabama Newsroom and correspondents like Carrington Cole. The station focuses on local government disputes, community fundraising efforts, and regional incidents affecting Alabama residents.

## Key Topics

- WAKA 8
- Lowndes County
- Tallapoosa County
- Alabama local government
- County commission conflicts
- Disaster relief
- Community fundraising
- West Alabama Newsroom
- Carrington Cole
- Sheriff charges
- Elected officials disputes
- Charitable giving
- Camp ASCCA
- Local business initiatives
- Emergency response

## Local Government & Legal Affairs

- [Dispute between elected officials moves forward in Lowndes Co.](https://www.waka.com/2024/11/14/dispute-between-elected-officials-moves-forward-in-lowndes-co/): Lowndes County sheriff-commission dispute heads to trial in Hayneville

## Community & Human Interest

- [Local woman makes t-shirts to help Texas communities devastated by recent fatal floods](https://www.waka.com/2025/07/22/local-woman-makes-t-shirts-to-help-texas-communities-devastated-by-recent-fatal-floods/): Taylor Moore's Tees by Taylor raises funds for Texas flood relief efforts
- [Camp ASCCA sent campers home after lightning struck and set fire to their dining hall](https://www.waka.com/2025/06/30/camp-ascca-sent-campers-home-after-lightning-struck-and-set-fire-to-their-dining-hall/): Lightning fire damages Camp ASCCA dining hall in Tallapoosa County
